Learn how to use what we learned the last 4 years (and a mobile app) to turn Texas blue | | | |
---
| | | **Hi,** **This is Sri Preston Kulkarni. I’m sitting in Austin right now, while my mother Margaret is watching her new granddaughter Nimi in Washington DC.**
**I’m writing first to thank you again for all the support you’ve given to me and my campaigns for Congress over the last 4 years. I hope you are proud of what we did in those races, of how close we got, how we mobilized our community in new ways (like running in 27 languages which other campaigns have tried to copy) and inspiring at least 13 different people from the campaign to run for office.

I also hope you are proud of the fact that the work we did in TX-22 helped lead to the successful effort to flip the entire state of Georgia in 2021 (where I spent 2 months campaigning), and win control of the entire U.S. Senate.

Well, I’m now back home in Texas, not running for Congress, but leading a project that will actually TURN TEXAS BLUE (seriously) IF we all do it together. The project is called the ****2 Million Texans Project****, and it’s based on how we used a mobile app (called Reach Progressive Organizing) to organize over 160,000 voters in less than a month in Georgia and increased turnout by 4% overall (and 11% with the least likely voters).** **These are unheard of numbers in campaigns and frankly, if we get everyone to do this program, we will BREAK the political advertising industry, because this program is all about talking to your own friends and family, with no ads, no strangers calling you at home, and no unknown text messages. If we are successful, unknown calls and text messages will go extinct in the next 2 years, and campaigns will be completely transformed in America forever.

I know all that sounds unbelievable (especially turning Texas blue), but the numbers don’t lie. Down below you can see a graph of how this program exploded with exponential growth in Georgia..and how we are already growing MUCH faster than Georgia. It’s simple, easy, free, and the most powerful campaign tool ever. But, it depends on all of us (at least 40,000 people across Texas) doing it to work.

So, that’s why I need your help. In order to get 40,000 people to download this app, we need everyone to do this and then tell their friends about it. We need seniors to do this, college students to do this, immigrants to do this. We need people outside of Texas to do this by downloading this app and finding their friends IN TEXAS who haven’t voted or calling other people to get them to do this. We need high school students and green card holders to find their friends who are 18 years old and US citizens and get them to do it. In short we need EVERYONE to do this.** | ******7:00 PM** **THIS MONDAY**
**[https://twomt.link/BigMeetingSignup](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=b47c573d10&e=e2c3d5ef2f)**
---

**With much appreciation,**
**Sri Kulkarni**
**Chief Strategist**
**2 Million Texans**

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this 🙏
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "I hope
you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319881:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319882:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "Footer Graphic 1")
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $25, 50, $75, or $100 today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61319882:JqGLuWV-N:m:1:3253819041:2467E1E3F76EECE713619343A640665E:r "Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?")**

Ron

This is not good, Peter. body:
Peter, together, we offered the people of New Hampshire a real choice they could be proud of. From taking on McCarthy, to calling out Fauci, to..
| [ ](https://email.baxterforcongress.com/e3t/Ctc/OR+113/d2p7Ng04/VWrPwk6p-fTjW8TMFdF6MXG2mW6wcfC_4Q7nW_N6Q02rQ3lLBmV1-WJV7Cg-8cVNZG2k5sNs5SVHtmfT1MPsdWW47zgqW8DCVGVW2qs90l5XQR-LW641dqq2xXY03N5C7bQ7pMFKFW5MnhKY8k2m7tVsXf2P8F5q_kW68_PR01d-sr6W2ZGF6d1mmLFWW901HgH2MZZVGW6GJkP87SmzBcN8xLLxd2P5PPW4fM5Vg3zQ8khW4rXsDC25kgDpW1YKwv53Lx2-HVQTSTk6H-d71W8Kb_-M8_lNHRN5wqxc6wHHnyVZ0wmQ5NZw5yW7ZwwGs1Qt_03W2tkQr-7N8qjN32tp1)
---
Peter, From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I started running for Congress at the age of 23. I had virtually no connections or major endorsements, and many considered me a joke candidate. I worked as hard as possible and made over 40,000 cold calls. So many people throughout our great state rallied behind me. To this day, it still gives me goosebumps. Our supporters knocked on nearly 100,000 doors, we raised over $500,000 and we earned the votes of almost 7,000 Granite Staters. Running for Congress and earning the support of so many Granite Staters was a tremendous honor. Running for Congress isn't easy. It's thrilling, yet draining. But, fighting for liberty is a tremendous privilege. I want to thank my family, my volunteers, my donors, and every voter that believed in me. Your support means the world to me and I will never forget it for as long as I live. Running for Congress required a tremendous sacrifice. I gave up essentially two years worth of income. I poured my heart and soul into the campaign. I fought as hard as I could. And I would do it all over again in a heartbeat. Together, we offered the people of New Hampshire a real choice they could be proud of. From taking on McCarthy, to calling out Fauci, to blasting Biden's reckless policies, I'm proud of the principled campaign we ran. Unfortunately, our grassroots campaign did not prevail. Super PACs for my major competitors spent about $6 million. Especially towards the end, the gap was too big to overcome. To all the people that believed in me, it breaks my heart that I wasn't able to do more to overcome this gap. And for that I am sorry. I wanted so badly to prevail, but unfortunately, our campaign didn't have enough gas in the tank. With this being said, no one likes a sore loser. That does not help the movement for freedom or the people of New Hampshire. I want to be clear, I give my full support to Karoline Leavitt. I hope she defeats Chris Pappas and retires him once and for all. While we were unable to secure the Republican nomination for New Hampshire's 1st congressional district, I refuse to give up. I'm planning to make an announcement in the near future about how I plan to continue my involvement. I can promise the people of New Hampshire this: I will be involved for years to come. Unfortunately, you can't get rid of me (haha)! I will grow my business, fight for liberty, and stay engaged in the community. Lastly, this will not be the end for me politically. I will be back. Our fight for liberty is far from over. Sincerely, Tim Baxter

name: Dan Crenshaw
subject: here's the truth
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Crenshaw for Congress
body:
---
| | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| Friends and fellow patriots,
I don't like being lied about. Yes, I know, it comes with the territory in politics. And as a result, most politicians ignore the lies and rumors, in the hopes they will go away on their own. It's part of the game, so I'm told.
Well, as you know, I don't accept that. I want our politics to be better. I think we should demand honesty and integrity and decency. And so I have made a habit of debunking the lies of the left, AND the lies of the right.
As you can imagine, that makes some people very, very angry. Sensational lies and rumors, especially about your own side, get clicks and engagement. The people spreading those lies make money off of this game, and the last thing they want is for someone like me to fight back.
But that's exactly what I do. At the end of this email you will see an excellent tweet thread from a supporter of mine who was sick of the lies and thoroughly debunked every crazy rumor that has been spread about me by our own side. But I first want to explain to you why I think it is so important to share this set of facts in the first place. I want to explain the nature of the people who spread them, and who they really are.
I call them the Woke Right.
These are people who wear the red jersey and say the right things, but in reality are not tethered to conservative principles. They want you to believe that "right-wing" and "conservative" are the same thing, but they are not. They know nothing about conservative philosophy and do nothing to further the conservative cause. Persuading those who disagree with us is not their goal; gaining your attention for clicks is. They have never read a book by Thomas Sowell or Ben Shapiro or Russell Kirk. They don't know who William F. Buckley was, and in fact they are closer to Bernie Bros than Buckley.
They gain attention by screaming "RINO!" at the top of their lungs, a word that has been rendered meaningless at this point, a sloppy epithet designed to bypass serious discussion or debate. They would attack and smear Ronald Reagan if he were alive today, and would certainly not have supported his hard stand against the Soviets.
Their North Star isn't conservatism or western principles, but rather rank contrarianism, driven by hatred of whatever they view as mainstream conservative thought. They are self-labeled "outsiders" even though they have usually spent their entire career in political media or trying to break through on political twitter. The Woke Right has become a refugee camp for disaffected Q Anon conspiracy theorists who believe 9/11 was an inside job, and Alt-Right provocateurs who despise our support for Israel and label anyone who disagrees a "globalist!".
They differ from the far left only in the color of the jersey they wear. The list of similarities is staggering:

* Both the far left and Woke Right want to tear down republican institutions if it means the smallest win for their side.
* Resentment is their primary motivator, and they are quick to feign victimhood over the smallest offense if it means more money in their pockets or more clout online.
* They believe all American foreign policy is a net negative for us and the world, and as a result they also despise the veterans who fought for our country.
* Both believe in total government takeover of tech and institutions if it suits their short term goals, but are quick to call for the defunding of law enforcement in the same breath.
* They are *obsessed* with petty tribalism, as if politics were not about ideological differences (it should be) but rather superficial high school cliques with ever-changing loyalty tests and idiosyncratic rituals and slogans.
* Winning is not their goal. Winning means the responsibility of governing and problem solving, which is the last thing they want. They thrive off conflict, not solutions.
* And both are driven by hatred, not inspiration nor higher ideals.

You may not have noticed these tactics or attributes before. Most good conservatives haven't, instead assuming that the influencers or politicians or media personalities they follow are all on the same team. You may be scratching your head, wondering who I am talking about specifically. I won't name names here (because thats exactly what many of them want. The attention), but instead hope that you will now have the tools to identify this type of so-called conservative and call them out as the Woke Right they really are.
I'm one of the few (maybe only) politicians that fights this toxic infiltration of our party, which has focused its fire on me for that very reason: I fight back. I do that because you support me and I feel it is my responsibility to lead our conservative movement back to the Reagan Revolution that inspired a generation and defeated communism.
I believe I need to give you the ammunition you need to do the same. We are all sick of the shameless and blatant lies, and many of you have asked me where they can find the truth so that you can help me push back.
That is why one of my supporters felt the need to put the below fact thread together. Please have a read and share it far and wide, and please continue to support my mission if you are able to. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Friends and fellow patriots, I don't like being lied about. Yes, I know, it comes with the territory in politics. And as a result, most politicians ignore the lies and rumors, in the hopes they will go away on their own. It's part of the game, so I'm told. Well, as you know, I don't accept that. I want our politics to be better. I think we should demand honesty and integrity and decency. And so I have made a habit of debunking the lies of the left, AND the lies of the right. As you can imagine, that makes some people very, very angry. Sensational lies and rumors, especially about your own side, get clicks and engagement. The people spreading those lies make money off of this game, and the last thing they want is for someone like me to fight back. But that's exactly what I do. At the end of this email you will see an excellent tweet thread from a supporter of mine who was sick of the lies and thoroughly debunked every crazy rumor that has been spread about me by our own side. But I first want to explain to you why I think it is so important to share this set of facts in the first place. I want to explain the nature of the people who spread them, and who they really are. I call them the Woke Right. These are people who wear the red jersey and say the right things, but in reality are not tethered to conservative principles. They want you to believe that "right-wing" and "conservative" are the same thing, but they are not. They know nothing about conservative philosophy and do nothing to further the conservative cause. Persuading those who disagree with us is not their goal; gaining your attention for clicks is. They have never read a book by Thomas Sowell or Ben Shapiro or Russell Kirk. They don't know who William F. Buckley was, and in fact they are closer to Bernie Bros than Buckley. They gain attention by screaming "RINO!" at the top of their lungs, a word that has been rendered meaningless at this point, a sloppy epithet designed to bypass serious discussion or debate. They would attack and smear Ronald Reagan if he were alive today, and would certainly not have supported his hard stand against the Soviets. Their North Star isn't conservatism or western principles, but rather rank contrarianism, driven by hatred of whatever they view as mainstream conservative thought. They are self-labeled "outsiders" even though they have usually spent their entire career in political media or trying to break through on political twitter. The Woke Right has become a refugee camp for disaffected Q Anon conspiracy theorists who believe 9/11 was an inside job, and Alt-Right provocateurs who despise our support for Israel and label anyone who disagrees a "globalist!". They differ from the far left only in the color of the jersey they wear. The list of similarities is staggering: Both the far left and Woke Right want to tear down republican institutions if it means the smallest win for their side. Resentment is their primary motivator, and they are quick to feign victimhood over the smallest offense if it means more money in their pockets or more clout online. They believe all American foreign policy is a net negative for us and the world, and as a result they also despise the veterans who fought for our country. Both believe in total government takeover of tech and institutions if it suits their short term goals, but are quick to call for the defunding of law enforcement in the same breath. They are obsessed with petty tribalism, as if politics were not about ideological differences (it should be) but rather superficial high school cliques with ever-changing loyalty tests and idiosyncratic rituals and slogans. Winning is not their goal. Winning means the responsibility of governing and problem solving, which is the last thing they want. They thrive off conflict, not solutions. * And both are driven by hatred, not inspiration nor higher ideals. You may not have noticed these tactics or attributes before. Most good conservatives haven't, instead assuming that the influencers or politicians or media personalities they follow are all on the same team. You may be scratching your head, wondering who I am talking about specifically. I won't name names here (because thats exactly what many of them want. The attention), but instead hope that you will now have the tools to identify this type of so-called conservative and call them out as the Woke Right they really are. I'm one of the few (maybe only) politicians that fights this toxic infiltration of our party, which has focused its fire on me for that very reason: I fight back. I do that because you support me and I feel it is my responsibility to lead our conservative movement back to the Reagan Revolution that inspired a generation and defeated communism. I believe I need to give you the ammunition you need to do the same. We are all sick of the shameless and blatant lies, and many of you have asked me where they can find the truth so that you can help me push back. That is why one of my supporters felt the need to put the below fact thread together. Please have a read and share it far and wide, and please continue to support my mission if you are able to. As I've said in the past, when you donate to my campaign your money does not sit and collect dust. Your money is put to immediate use growing our conservative movement so we can win and provide a better future for our country based on the principles of our Founding. Peter,

Today, a new ad was released in support of Governor DeSantis featuring an Angel Mom with a story that EVERYONE needs to hear.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=d93066b3dce2ee263ab29aed017ceacb831d361e2a01debb84136ca752c494440c068c82b6ff4a27a4ca57d24d7e984e2ebf39d74699fcb8

Governor DeSantis and I first met Kiyan Michael after hearing the story of her son Brandon, who was tragically killed by a twice-deported illegal immigrant.

No one should have to go through what Kiyan and her husband went through, burying their son when he was just 21 years old.

After hearing Kiyan’s story, along with the stories of countless other innocent families who have suffered the consequences of open border policies, Ron promised to take action to better protect our state from the impacts of illegal immigration.

To combat the Biden-Crist border crisis, Governor DeSantis stood up for Florida:

▪️ Governor DeSantis banned sanctuary cities in the state of Florida and requires state and local governments to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement.

▪️ In 2021, the Governor deployed state law enforcement to help secure the southern border, becoming the first state to answer Texas and Arizona’s call for assistance.

▪️ Governor DeSantis delivered on his promise to relocate illegal immigrants to places that “claim” to welcome illegal immigrants.

▪️ Governor DeSantis increased the sentence for trafficking fentanyl and added methamphetamine to the list of drugs eligible for life in prison for those who sell them and cause the loss of a life.

I launched a statewide campaign to inform the public of the dangers of fentanyl to educate the youth on the life-altering effects of drug use through my The Facts. Your Future. initiative. name: American Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0714%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=vQFnjx08HegfnBUK4IYgWQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33345%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Tw51bVNHrtwTSQRf7Mzhpw&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33346%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=u6hL9rxUiW%2bQQT2t%2b0noXA&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33346%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=u6hL9rxUiW%2bQQT2t%2b0noXA&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;” Reaching over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsadBVchNN

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osadBVchNN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60793666:sadBVchNN:m:3:2532013465:167C6F11CB323BA29EDA48FEB9868E0C:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60793666:sadBVchNN:m:3:2532013465:167C6F11CB323BA29EDA48FEB9868E0C:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

clean_body: Right now, we’re two veterans working together on one mission: Defeat Nancy Pelosi.| | | Peter, When I meet another Navy veteran, I know I’m in good company. There is a special bond for men who fought on the same battlefield. And Derrick Van Orden isn’t just any veteran: he’s a former Navy Seal. As a Navy Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Officer, I served with SEALs like Derrick Van Orden. It is our common love for this Republic that drives us. Right now, we’re two veterans working together on one mission: Defeat Nancy Pelosi. Derrick and I put our lives on the line in the desert and the mountains around the world to keep America safe. Nancy Pelosi can barely lift a finger if it isn’t perfectly manicured. Now, she’s sending her high-dollar California donors in after us with a $100 MILLION bounty. It’s time to show her that NOTHING beats the Navy. Derrick and I know that freedom isn’t free, Peter. We’ve seen our friends and fellow soldiers make the ultimate sacrifice to defend America, and in everything we do, we NEVER forget them. But the only sacrifice Nancy Pelosi only thinks about his having to cancel her shopping trip to take a meeting with a mega-donor lobbyist. For too long, Congress has been filled with Washington politicians who have the WRONG kind of experience. Derrick Van Orden and I are working to change that and fill Congress with REAL leaders. subject: It's A Little Complicated... | From The Desk Of Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer
body:
It's A Little Complicated If I could use a word to honestly describe me, it would be COMPLICATED. This is one of the reasons I love the Bible and c
| | |
---
## It's A Little Complicated
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8422.1.a525e98062d69f8c028b32cf337b06eb)
---
If I could use a word to honestly describe me, it would be **COMPLICATED**.
This is one of the reasons I love the Bible and can so easily relate with the men and women in the Bible.
God used complicated people like **Abraham** who was a liar and yet the Father of our Faith, **David** who was an Adulterer and Murderer while also being a man after God's own heart. **They were complicated.**
The more I mature in Christ, the more I discover how complicated I am.
In the Old Testament, there was a man who could easily be the definition of complicated. His name was **Jacob**.
Sunday, at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8423.1.783ad6c940079ace78c60f2e45c52b0e), I preached a sermon on Jacob and how for the vast majority of his life he pretended to be someone that he was not.
We all can find ourselves being poor carbon copies of others instead of the original we were created to be.
The truth is: **God cannot bless the pretend you, He can only bless the real you.**
It is time to break free from the mask and the facade; live the REAL life you were born to live.
You can watch "[It's A Little Complicated](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8424.1.02fe5c2cd71f16f35aea734b1526f8bf)" by clicking the link: [https://youtu.be/ea290-UOvVs?t=2](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8425.1.c6ec55a1a57b4241a3cc287c1f76be83)
Also, I have started a new series on Wednesday nights at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8426.1.d9f3ebd5e805c82b025cbb11b77d0bf7) over the **Book of Revelation**.
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8427.1.0fdb02440c5c42639cdaeba406f8a661)
---
We are taking our time through the **Book of Revelation** by going verse by verse.
Watch Pt. 1 here: [https://youtu.be/oPfmX_Aus-M?t=2](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8428.1.888a067c03348dbf4dea8e75fd7c9d9a)
---
## HUGE News!
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8429.1.e5c2e9e5dcaf565a06d9449f98530ba4)
---
It's the _honor of my life_ to be the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8430.1.e9604a8ed1147ea75b8169686c78eeaf) in Tulsa, OK.
God has blessed our church with **tremendous growth**.
Last year, we launched a second Sunday service to make room for the growth.
Currently, we have services every Sunday at 9 & 11 am as well as Wednesday at 7pm.
**Our current location has been amazing, but we are outgrowing it.**
On Sundays at 11 am, I will find myself in the church lobby watching cars circle our parking lot trying to find a place to park because we have run out of parking before the service even begins and as a Pastor that's a horrible thing to see because your heart's desire is to reach people.
Last year, we began seeking the Lord for _direction_ on addressing this good problem.
God has poured out His favor on [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8431.1.c15921462390767f707dee120750a4c8)!
We have **acquired 6 acres in South Tulsa** between 81st and 91st off of Memorial.
I approached the owner of the 8 acres attached to the 6 acres we have acquired and asked what he would sell it to [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8432.1.e89e70ca0f929761390c0095428f80c8) for and his response was reasonable. He said, "$750,000."
I then asked him if he would take $100,000 and he said, "**yes**."
**That's a MIRACLE!**
We are in a position to purchase 8 acres of prime real estate in South Tulsa for $100,000 that could be the potential home of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8433.1.fa6b8b93a8328bbc92df2c7adb453285) in the future.
Currently, [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8434.1.ff6e5bed5bbea83f2c76a1b07e99f68b) is debt free, and I believe we should remain debt free.
**In order to remain out of debt, I need your help.**
We need to raise $100,000 over the next 60 days.
**So far, we have raised $11,105!**
I'm asking for you to come partner with what God is doing through [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8435.1.f3a7712d3fece355e046c1b8cfbc9b32) and help expand the Kingdom of God.
A gift of $5 or $500 will be a HUGE help.
**If everyone that this email goes out to does something, we will have more than enough to acquire the 8 acres in cash.**
God is doing great things at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8436.1.95ab834119534faa3af4acf239da88ad), and I believe if you help bless God's house that in-return God will bless your house.
Please ask the Lord if this is a project that you should partner with us in.
You can partner with us by visiting [www.sheridan.church/give](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8437.1.0b2e677000e3fa3be4ecd4a320c10f39) and know that I am beyond grateful for your help.
To see the land, watch this video announcement here: [https://youtu.be/GEth9C0quzU](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8438.1.c8221122d5681f8c633d0b1cf80021a2)
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer
Follow me on [TruthSocial](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8439.1.8cb127eab4bf59e9951ea9fa871a5cb3), GAB, [Facebook](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8440.1.be78e441583c9486f175e1472a3e9536), [Instagram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8441.1.9ef063d82b1756694bbf23380743fdeb), [Twitter](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8442.1.5d95a68a25bf9e0a790842aaf8667fab), [Telegram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8443.1.2d02d4f3e82565e350ec1544b2a9d530), GETTR & [YouTube](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14418427.8444.1.a5f7dec7b4f74257d950f81bd261a35a)).

| September 19, 2022

| | Friends,

Welcome back to _**Russell's Roundup**_ , your weekly source for the latest on Russell Fry's campaign to Congress to take back the House!

---
| **On Tap This Week:**

_Tuesday, September 20:_ Chesterfield County Day
* 3:00pm-5:00pm — Meet & Greet with Russell Fry at The Caffeinated Cow. 158 2nd Street Cheraw, SC
* 6:00pm-7:00pm — Chesterfield County GOP Meeting at The Wine Factory. 165 2nd Street Cheraw, SC

|
---
---
| | | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=c721a3434a&e=7aa6ac5965)
---

**#RussellOnTheRoad**
Campaign season is here and Russell is hitting the road once again!

Reply to this email and let us know where Russell should visit this fall.
---
|
---
| **ENDORSEMENT ALERT**

Russell is honored to have received three distinguished endorsements as your Republican nominee for South Carolina's 7th district.
---
|
---
**Congresswoman Kat Cammack and the American GRIT PAC on their endorsement: ** “Russell Fry is a father, a husband, and a State Representative, and in his home state of South Carolina, he has been a champion of conservative values. Russell has been a leader his entire life, and is a true America First patriot. It’s my pleasure to welcome Russell to Team Grit, and I urge you to join me in supporting his campaign for Congress in SC-07!”
|
---
**The NFIB, National Federation of Independent Business, on their endorsement: ** “The National Federation of Independent Business, the nation's leading small business advocacy organization, endorsed Russell Fry for election to the United States House of Representatives to represent South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District.

‘Russell Fry has been a tireless supporter of small businesses during his time in the state legislature, with a near perfect voting record on small business issues,’ said Ben Homeyer, NFIB South Carolina State Director. ‘He worked to keep South Carolina’s small businesses open during the COVID-19 government shutdowns, advocated for small business tax cuts, and fought to keep the state’s Unemployment Insurance trust fund funded. He has committed to focusing on top small business issues in Congress including high inflation, worker shortages, and supply chain issues. We are pleased to endorse him today’.
‘On behalf of South Carolina’s small businesses, we are proud to endorse Russell Fry for election,’ said Sharon Sussin, NFIB Senior National Political Director. ‘He understands the issues that small business owners are facing and will continue to be a consistent supporter for them in Congress’.
_The endorsement is issued from NFIB FedPAC, NFIB’s political action committee. NFIB FedPAC is funded by voluntary contributions by NFIB members over and above their membership dues. Decisions made by the NFIB FedPAC are managed by a member-driven grassroots evaluation.”_
|
---
**The NRA, National Rifle Association **

Russell is proud to receive the NRA's endorsement along with an "A" rating. He has fought tirelessly to protect our Second Amendment rights during his time in the State House and he will continue to do so on the federal level for all Americans.
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=4a6894c3fc&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**#ICYMI (In Case You Missed It) **

Russell had an AWESOME time in Aynor at the infamous annual Harvest Hoe Down!

"People were fired up ready for November! Over and over I heard from families and how tired they were of Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi's failed policies. They see it every day at the grocery store, at the gas pump, and in their paycheck. They see it at the VA and when they want to buy a home Most of all, they want a return to sane policies that grow wealth and allow their families to thrive again. And that's EXACTLY the agenda Republicans will push for when we retake the majority in November!"

---
|
---

From the Sun News: “We’ve always handed this country off to the next generation a little bit better than we found it. But I will be damned if this is the first generation that says, ‘America’s best days are behind it’”.

Check out the full article [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=7593e3f9e2&e=7aa6ac5965)!

This election isn't going to win itself. We need everything you can give to dethrone the Democrats! Click [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=1afbad26e7&e=7aa6ac5965) to donate.

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Former US Senator Endorses Erik Aadland
body:
| | | |
---
---
| Senator Cory Gardner Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from former United States Senator, Cory Gardner.

Cory Gardner served as a United States senator from Colorado from 2015 to 2021. Gardner is a native Coloradan who attended Colorado State University and The University of Colorado obtaining his law degree. From 2005 to 2021, Gardner served in various offices representing Colorado in the Colorado House of Representatives (2005-2011), the US House of Representatives (2011-2015) and the US Senate (2015-2021).

Politically, Senator Gardner is known for introducing the "National Suicide Hotline Designation Act" creating a new nationwide three-digit phone number (988), and the "Great American Outdoors Act" funding the Land and Water Conservation Fund towards federal lands.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Senator Gardner said:
"The people of Colorado deserve a battle-tested leader who will listen and fight for them. That's why I've endorsed Erik Aadland for Congress. Erik is a man of principle who has lived by a core set of values his whole life. He was born into a military family, graduated from West Point, fought for America in the War Against Terrorism, and now he's running to serve our great nation in Washington. A warrior like him is exactly who we need to bridge the divides and fight for our values. We need to get America back on track and it starts by electing Erik Aadland."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am distinctly honored to receive Senator Gardner's endorsement, recognizing the significant service he has rendered Colorado and this great nation. His example is admirable and one I will strive to emulate. Senator Gardner faithfully demonstrated over many years what it takes to represent the people of our remarkable state, and I am humbled to have his confidence in me. "
---
---
| |
---
---

---
| |
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York, or shady philanthropists backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

clean_body: | | | Friend, I defeated a 30-year incumbent. I became the first female and the first minority governor of South Carolina. I have won every election I’ve ever had... And I don’t intend to start losing now. That’s why I’m writing you this important message. You’ve probably seen my messages about the nearly 60 staunch conservatives I’ve endorsed this election cycle and how crucial and competitive their races are. That’s why I founded Stand For America PAC in the first place — so I could train, endorse, advise, and financially support strong candidates in state and federal races across the country. I understand what it feels like to be the underdog, underestimated by everyone. Growing up as a brown girl in rural South Carolina, people told me I was too young, too brown, too conservative, too female to accomplish my goals. But being told I couldn’t do something just made me fight even harder. So I fought, and I proved them wrong time and again. I’m bringing what I learned from every race I’ve run to this election cycle. I’m helping bold Republican leaders across this country. The underdogs in districts that haven’t been won in over 90 years. The American patriots who spent decades serving our country who are ready to take on a new form of service. The Republicans who are tirelessly fending off tens of millions of dollars worth of attack ads. I’m here for them. I’m fighting for them. Democrats are underestimating us. They know they have the resources to flood the airwaves with deceptions. They know the polls are narrowing. body:
I hope you can see why this is *so* important.
#
Hey Derek, it’s Brendan, John Fetterman’s campaign manager.
I’m reaching out with an important question: **[Is there anything I can say to get you to make your very first donation to our campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220919-7310&refcode2=7310_434096_TqIgJO&akid=7310%2E434096%2ETqIgJO)**
**Let me start by saying that...**
1\. Pennsylvania is the #1 swing state most likely to flip on CNN’s top 10 list.
2\. If Democrats don’t maintain (and expand) our Senate majority, the Republicans will vote on a national abortion ban — _Sen. Lindsey Graham said so himself last week._
3\. Dr. Oz refuses to answer the question about how he would vote on a national abortion ban. But he also referred to abortion as “murder,” so...
**[What do you think, Derek? Can I count on you to make your first $5 donation today? Every donation helps, no matter the amount.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220919-7310&refcode2=7310_434096_TqIgJO&akid=7310%2E434096%2ETqIgJO)**
**[I'm ready to give»](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220919-7310&refcode2=7310_434096_TqIgJO&akid=7310%2E434096%2ETqIgJO)**
If that didn’t get you to chip in, please spare me one more minute of your time.
**Did you know...**
4\. The last time this seat was up, it set the record for the most expensive Senate race of _ALL TIME._
5\. Dr. Oz has already poured millions of his TV-scam-doctor money into our race, pushing out ads that straight up lie about John and our campaign.
6\. A Mitch McConnell aligned Super PAC is also jumping in to interfere with our race and spread lies about John — they booked millions of dollars worth of TV air time right before Election Day.
**Finally, Derek, here is my favorite fact I need you to know:**
7\. We don’t accept _any_ corporate PAC money. We’re funding this campaign with grassroots donations collected over simple emails like this one, from real people like you from Cresco.
**[Okay, now that I’ve said all that, I have to ask one more time: Can I get you to chip in your very first donation? It would make a big difference now that we’re just 7 weeks away from Election Day.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220919-7310&refcode2=7310_434096_TqIgJO&akid=7310%2E434096%2ETqIgJO)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220919-7310&refcode2=7310_434096_TqIgJO&akid=7310%2E434096%2ETqIgJO)**
If none of that convinced you, or if you can’t give at all, I get it. It’s a tough time and not everyone has extra money to donate to political campaigns. But if you are in a position to give, **[right now is the best time to do so.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220919-7310&refcode2=7310_434096_TqIgJO&akid=7310%2E434096%2ETqIgJO)**
We can’t afford to give up one inch of progress to Dr. Oz and the GOP.
Thank you,
Brendan

Peter,
I wanted to take a moment and personally update you on the latest from HQ.
With roughly one month until early voting begins in our race, we're about to launch our first flight of TV ads, mailers, and we're continuing to run a robust, door-to-door field program throughout the district. We’re also countering the attacks being run by Kevin McCarthy’s super PAC.
**Your dollars are being put to work, and I want to stress that none of this would have been possible without your ongoing support.**
I've never been high on the idea that money is the end-all to winning an election. But what I do believe in is spending resources wisely and effectively. I'm not exaggerating when I say this is widely considered the most competitive race in the country. We can't leave anything to chance, and YOU are helping us accomplish that.
September 30th marks our final FEC fundraising deadline before the General Election. My campaign team got together and set an ambitious goal of raising $55,000 in online donations before the deadline hits. This is doable, but we’re still short of that mark. Today, I’m hoping you can chip in $5 to help us keep this campaign running strong. Thanks in advance,

name: =?utf-8?Q?Courtney?=
subject: “I’m from the government—and I’m here to help you.”
body:
We've heard that before. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e78a29ecdfa1/valerie-offers-no-solutions-in-town-hall-last-night-9062285?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
I’m Courtney Geels, candidate for Congress in your District, NC 4, and here’s what I know.

Once upon a time, Kings could do anything they wanted to you. Steal your land, throw you in a dungeon, have you murdered. Americans invented a better system—no Kings— and elected a Congress to make laws to protect people’s lives and property.

It worked because the government’s power was LIMITED. 246 years later, **your government** **DOES NOT WANT ITS POWER LIMITED**.
---
| [ ](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=2374ae95e7&e=20ac8f046f)
---
Government overreach is increasing by the hour.
| | | Like the Kings of old, it does what it wants:

"Take a shot--or lose your job.

"Stop complaining and cheer the transgender 'girl' competing against your daughter, while that biological male mocks your daughter’s hard work and sacrifice."

"You parents had better be quiet and get out of **OUR **School Board Meeting right now...or we might just brand you as Domestic Terrorists. We've got the FBI and the US Attorney General on speed dial, you know!"

"Get used to being poorer. Get used to sweating in summer and shivering in winter, because GREEN ENERGY MUST HAPPEN NOW, no matter what the cost to low-income people. It's for your own good!"

"Don't say anything politically incorrect or we’ll sic our 87,000 new IRS agents on you. Have fun being audited!"** **

"We are **SMARTER** than you, and we are **BETTER** than you. So shut up, and do what we say." (Thomas Sowell, _The Vision of the Anointed_)

My name is Courtney Geels. I am** NOT ANOINTED, smarter than you, or morally superior to you**. I’m just a nurse who wants to serve you and your neighbors—of all parties and races—to be YOUR representative in Congress. To represent you with humility and with common sense.
---
---
|
For truth, justice, and unity,

Courtney Geels

---
|
---
|
---

| | | | | Peter, **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb7f3bcb2-4ef2-4bbd-9a21-d000d84f0222/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **

He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money. So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE. | | | | | | This would ensure that along with the bias towards small states (ie Wyoming having as many Senators as California), monied interests who've already bought state legislators would get to pick Senators in larger states where they've gerrymandered Democrats into a minority (see Ohio, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Texas, etc). Meanwhile, Maggie Hassan is one of the most forceful voices on codifying Roe, protecting women's rights and ensuring MORE PEOPLE VOTE, not fewer like millions fewer as Bolduc wants. We must defeat Republicans in November. We must, in particular, defeat dangerous extremist Bolduc and reelect Senator Maggie Hassan in New Hampshire. We not only need this great Senator in the Senate, but her seat could decide whether we remain in the majority or Mitch McConnell becomes the new Senate leader. Thank you for keeping up the fight! name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Our last “end-of-quarter”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220919&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220919&amount=28]
Well folks,
It’s that time again. The end of the third fiscal quarter of the year -- the final full fiscal quarter before the election-- is right around the corner on September 30.
And yes, that does mean your inbox is about to get a bit more crowded with candidates explaining just how important that September 30th deadline is. Apologies in advance. In the spirit of transparency, let me take a moment to explain why this upcoming deadline is so important.
I’ve told you before that people running for office are federally required to report how much money they’ve raised and how much they have in the bank four times a year, at the end of each fiscal quarter. And, I’ve told you that the numbers reported at the end of each quarter are one of the best indicators of a campaign's continued strength. They show how much money each candidate is working with, if the campaign is being run in a sustainable way (aka, if they are raising enough money to keep up with how much they are spending), and the level of grassroots support behind each candidate.
It also gives both allies and competitors a gauge of what flexibility you have for those crazy 5 final weeks of the campaign, where pop-up issues are the norm.
Since this is our last “end-of-quarter” before Election Day – it’s our last chance to tangibly show our strength ahead of the election. These end-of-quarter numbers will be published on October 15th, so right before the election. And frankly, the last month is when the funds you donate can be put to maximum use.
I’ve made it a priority to never spam your inbox by pushing fake deadlines or creating a false sense of urgency. Which is why I only ever bring up the deadlines that actually matter – like this upcoming one on September 30th.
So, I hope you’ll bear with me as we head into our last “end-of-quarter” push before Election Day. And, if you’re willing, chip in below to help us finish out these next few weeks strong. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220919&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220919&amount=28]
Elissa

subject: Lincoln’s secret weapon
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Eucli
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi858s4k4m088hs5d11ucfmo1scfomned9sbn1e0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sdlecqjcdtgs1geadb4s8qjecbkmmomfc73elp38pj1cmrj1cr4ehibco3j6grjfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32cljcdg7cob6eljjbc37m2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm6pj3chie2ob0c8iv0)
| | | This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2za1ss50man18ih2gbvhvaq7vcocdf229gdtg7qog_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdi69ob1c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zu86c12l0i0spomvt3akme3hv2igqnpdpo75u0lo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdi69ob1c1h2bs)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z784d4miots0epc7gab6mqg1fo9ej8j9t7stdhtg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdi69ob1c1h2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Polling shows key Senate races in states like Nevada and Georgia locked neck and neck, while GOP megadonors flood these battleground states with millions of dollars to tip the scales in their favor. I know that we can take them on — and we can win. But if we're going to build a strategy strong enough to keep the Senate out of Mitch McConnell's control, we need input from the most committed grassroots Democrats. That's why I'm personally asking for your help today. Before midnight tonight, I'm looking for another 27 of the most engaged members of this team to let me know which issue they think Democrats should make a top priority in the final weeks of the midterms — and I'm counting on your response, friend: Which issue do you think is most important heading into the midterm elections? | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Thank you so much for weighing in, Kirsten | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Antonio and U.S. Senator Sherrod Brown! | | The contrast for this election couldn't be clearer. While we're building up our grassroots labor support, my opponent Max Miller was recorded calling working people “takers” and stated workers “have a sense of entitlement” and that they “take take take take but they never give.” We’re not taking Max out of context. Max showed his contempt for the hardworking people of Ohio’s 7th district. The vast majority of us have worked hard our entire adult lives to make ends meet, but Max Miller says we’re “entitled” and all we do is “take.” Max thinks that hardworking Ohioans just leach off of rich people like him. body:
Team,
We’re 50 days out from Election Day — and EVERYTHING is riding on this race.
Kevin McCarthy and his right-wing colleagues know winning Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District hands them the keys to Congress.
And, with Congress in their grip, Congressional Republicans can satisfy their extremist base by gutting affordable health care for working families or passing a national abortion ban.
Right here in the 3rd Congressional District, we’re facing down one of the country’s top five most extreme Republicans. A radical candidate with no Wisconsin values.
We can’t kid ourselves.
Right-wing Republicans are dumping obscene amounts of money into this contest because they’re desperate to flip our district.
Everything they have planned for the next Congress depends on winning this seat. Without it, they’re on the trash heap.
Everyone, I’m giving it my all. I’m ready to go to Washington to continue standing up for Wisconsin’s hardworking women and men, our farmers and blue-collar workers, our kids, seniors, and veterans.
I’m ready to work to ensure all Wisconsinites can access affordable health care. And I’m ready to help make Wisconsin’s manufacturing sector a national leader in our manufacturing economy.
With so much at stake, will you join me? Can you chip in $50 (or even $5) to help protect our shared values?

body:
These are the five best pick-up opportunities for Democrats this November.
| Friends \-

If you're looking for the best way to make a difference in this November's election, look no further than these five candidates who can flip Republican-held Senate seats:
* John Fetterman in Pennsylvania
* Cheri Beasley in North Carolina
* Val Demings in Florida
* Tim Ryan in Ohio
* And yours truly in Wisconsin

**We're calling ourselves the Flippable Five. Because the ONLY way we will successfully expand the Senate majority this November is by flipping these five critical seats from red to blue.**

It's become pretty clear that the 50-50 Senate is not enough. We need to elect more Democrats to the Senate in order to pass bold legislation to address the needs of working families.

So if you're ready to expand the Senate majority and you want to make a real difference in this November's election, then I hope you will consider splitting a contribution between our campaigns.

We're counting on significant grassroots support in order to win our races. That is why I am asking you directly: [**Please split a contribution of $7 or more between John Fetterman, Cheri Beasley, Val Demings, Tim Ryan, my campaign, and Voter Protection Project today to flip these five Senate seats and expand the Senate majority. Your generous contribution will make a big difference for our campaigns.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26229?t=6&akid=4573%2E878179%2Ezc-P7a) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Cheri Beasley, Mandela Barnes, Val Demings, Tim Ryan, John Fetterman, and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26230?t=7&akid=4573%2E878179%2Ezc-P7a)

Mitch McConnell's super PAC has booked $66 million in advertising across Pennsylvania, North Carolina and Wisconsin, and many of those ads are now up on the air. But that is only a small portion of the outside spending that is going to pour into our races.

Right-wing dark-money groups are prepared to spend absurd amounts of money to defend these Republican-held Senate seats. They are running deceptive and vicious ads against all five of us because they know we're in a strong position to win these seats for Democrats.

It is very likely that we will be outspent, but we cannot be out-organized. With less than 8 weeks to go until Election Day, we urgently need to bring together a broad coalition in Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Florida, Ohio, and Wisconsin.

All five of these races are expected to be decided by a handful of votes. The only way we will come out on top is with unprecedented grassroots support.

All my best,

Mandela Barnes

This campaign is going to take all of us.
#
**It's official: We have exactly 50 days until the election.**
We have a detailed plan to win, but we can only execute it with your help. [**If you're ready to elect Beto and defeat Greg Abbott on November 8, can we count on you to chip in $3 immediately?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220919-1.1xMsPj&refcode=ema20220919-208601&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=208601%2E444211%2EsX_J3G)
Beto and our supporters have inspired over 90,000 Texans to knock on doors, call voters, and write letters to their neighbors — but to win, we must turn out more voters than Texas has ever seen. Here's the plan:
→ Until October 2, we'll be in the "voter ID" phase of this campaign where we talk to hundreds of thousands of voters, ask them who they're voting for, and collect the contact information we'll need to follow up before Election Day.

Big banks, prominent economists

certainty. This financial move may give you a chance to make it.
Details

Urgent Release for Americans,
The cost of everything is on the
rise! Whether you think it is Putin's fault or not is irrelevant
at this stage, you need a solution for this economic menace
before it forces you to your knees.
The rising costs of healthcare,
gas and food have caused many to worry about what's coming next.
As an individual, you have spent
decades building up the savings required to get through
retirement; however, with inflation at an all time-high, and many
unforeseen events taking place recently, the focus has shifted
from retiring comfortably to covering basic necessities. Your
savings are being depleted by inflation, and action must be
taken.
This Protection Guide will
help you find out how to secure your wealth.
And in times like these, it's
reasonable to forgo many things to survive, but not taking action
against a stock market downfall is not one of them.
As our economy is heading into a
possible recession, the right investment can level the playing
field and help stop the financial bleeding and pain felt by so
many.
Your money is eroding at a rapid
pace, and economists are certain that the stock market is taking
its last breath, before it crashes.
This Protection Guide shows you
what may be on the horizon and how to protect your retirement.

During the Bernstein conference
in June 2022, JP Morgan Chase President & CEO Jamie Dimon warned
us to brace ourselves for an economic hurricane. Dimon added that
this distorted economy is caused by inflation and spiking
interest rates.

Robert Kiyosaki in one of his recent tweets acknowledged that

economic challenge that may soon be coming: "The biggest crash in
world history is coming. Get more gold, silver…"
Real physical assets are high in
demand and are the insurance that every retiree needs to protect
their wealth during challenging times like these.
Get your Protection Guide Kit
and protect your savings.

subject: unions are the backbone of America
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Trudy is fiercely proud to have been endorsed by dozens of labor unions.
| | |
---
Peter – Trudy is fiercely proud to have been endorsed by dozens of labor unions – including the Missouri AFL-CIO, UAW, Midwest States, the Missouri-Kansas-Nebraska Conference of Teamsters, and the UA Plumbers and Pipefitters Local 562.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50979326/367851866/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk320-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDRhN2YxYS02NzM4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fym0pe7bKB6ok8wB8aYrKfznzdXYhFtUKcjppCajURA=)
Growing up, Trudy saw the strength of unions firsthand. Her family's business was a proud employer of union workers and was able to better serve them due to their collective voice and ability to make their needs clear.
Their unions made sure that every single worker went home with fair wages, helping them build their own families' futures and achieve their very own American Dream.**Because of unions, Trudy's family's success story is also a success story for all of St. Louis and Missouri.**
**Trudy knows that unions are the backbone of America – and that working families are counting on our leaders to defend unions against growing attacks from corporate-funded extremists.** In Washington, you can count on her to work day and night to win real protections for our unions. Trudy supports passing the PRO Act and raising the minimum wage to $15 an hour, and she believes the ultra rich and massive corporations should pay their fair share.
