name: Jim Mast
subject: Will you help my veteran son?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MAST FOR CONGRESS
body:
Today is the anniversary of the day my son got blown up while kicking terrorist ass in Afghanistan – a day that our family has referred to as his “Alive Day.” [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0720%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=oK4OHfDlRua7eyqCgsLRgw&sysid=1)
|
---
| |
---
| | Friend,
---
| Today is the anniversary of the day my son got blown up while kicking terrorist ass in Afghanistan - a day that our family has referred to as his “Alive Day.”

Now, he’s running for Congress to kick Nancy Pelosi’s butt and take on the radical left, but in order to do that, he needs your support. In a minute, I’m going to ask you to [make a small donation to help him win](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33408%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XMMvEWvVCGh61FqK5ocOaw&sysid=1), but first, let me explain why this is so important...
---
| [ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33409%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1R618mG6qvYPvv2i3sL90g&sysid=1)
---
| I remember the day Brian’s sister called me 12 years ago to deliver the news. My heart sank - I worried that his newborn son was about to be growing up without a father. I worried that I would never be able to tell my own son the words “I love you” ever again.

Thankfully, my worst fears didn’t come true - Brian survived losing two legs and a part of his hand in that horrific explosion. When I got to the hospital, I made sure that the very first thing I told Brian was that I loved him.

But quickly, that became tough love. I told my son that he had to find a way to bounce back. He couldn’t leave all of his service to his nation behind him.

And even more importantly - he couldn’t let his kids see him feeling sorry for himself.

Boy did Brian take that to heart. Over the years, I watched him recover from his injuries, learn to walk again, graduate college and continue his service fighting his ass off once again for our country as Republican representative for the state of Florida. I’m a proud father.

This year though, my son’s mission to continue that service is different than years past.

That’s because he’s focused on an important task this Election Year - getting accountability for failures in the same military operation where he lost his legs.

You see, Joe Biden is a complete coward, and he turned his back on Brian (not to mention all of the other veterans who served nobly alongside him) when he abandoned the mission in Afghanistan.

So, my son is doing what he does best: fighting back and looking to get accountability for Joe Biden’s failure. Troops were killed and allies were abandoned, and Brian is on a mission to ensure that all who were in charge of this disaster are held responsible.

But in order to do so, he first needs to win his election and help other Republicans take back the majority in Congress.

That takes resources - and I really hope that Brian doesn’t have to focus on raising money of all things during such an important personal time for him.

So I want to ask - as a kind gesture for Brian’s Alive Day and to help him in his mission to get accountability for Afghanistan... [_Will you pitch in to support my son’s campaign today?_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33400%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1DgDaqcNOSp4NOILDLeZ0A&sysid=1)

His team told me he still needs to raise another _$50,000_ this month in order to hit their goals at this stage in the Election Year.
---
| [PLEASE, DONATE TO HELP MY SON BRIAN](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33401%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tb7bDmUf5kFhj0ncoYVxjQ&sysid=1 "PLEASE, DONATE TO HELP MY SON BRIAN")
---
| I appreciate this support, and I know Brian does as well. Thank you for coming together to have his back.

Sincerely,
_Jim Mast_

name: Joe Kent
subject: a short runway
body:
Dear Supporter,
I know for a fact that your email inbox is filled with donation requests from candidates all over the country making their case for why you should contribute to them.
But unlike all of the other races in this country, mine is unique: I have an extremely short runway.
Our primary was one of the last of the election cycle, and the outcome wasn't resolved until the middle of August.
And our General Election starts three weeks earlier because that's when Washington State sends out mail ballots to every registered voter.
It's vital that we raise the necessary funds QUICKLY so we can pay for TV, radio, and digital ads, direct mail, and our massive door knocking operation. Can you make a contribution today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate?r=g01](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg/uUXXmJI13ubh1tuwnhShAA)?
This is a must-win race for Republicans to take back the House of Representatives. If we don't win here, it's unlikely we'll be able to stop Biden's agenda of open borders, inflation, and an out of control FBI and Department of Justice.
That's why this race and your support of my campaign is so important. Please, help us take back the House by contributing to my campaign at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate?r=g01](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg/uUXXmJI13ubh1tuwnhShAA).
My opponent has gone on the record supporting Biden's phony "Inflation Reduction Act" that will actually cause more inflation, puts new taxes on energy, and hires 87,000 new IRS agents to target middle-income Americans. She would be another extremist foot soldier for the Biden-Pelosi Agenda that has put our country into recession.
Please, help me win this election so we can have another America First fighter in Congress who will put you, your family, and our country first every day. Please make a contribution today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate?r=g01](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/n1G2Pc763tT4r763h358MmAJWg/uUXXmJI13ubh1tuwnhShAA).
Thank you,
Joe Kent

| | | Fellow Conservative,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

In a moment, I am going to share with you my plan for the last 50 days of the election, but first I have to ask: [**The election is approaching quickly, and my team is hoping to raise $5,000 today to help power us through the final days ahead. Can you chip in just $5 before the day ends?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50980366/367855899/-982101463?refcode=em_fr_2022.09.19_b2_cd_all&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMGM1M2Q5OS02YTM4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i3pkaWtsq7EcFwAGm3b5jvFk0ThLpu3_IJNTjOhhUoo=)

50 days, friend. That's how long we have to defeat Marco Rubio, flip Florida blue and win Senate control.
**It's going to be tough, but I'm no stranger to a challenge.** Growing up poor, Black and female in the South, no one gave me a chance to do much of anything. But with hard work, I became the first in my family to go to college – then onto being Orlando's first female chief of police and later a U.S. congresswoman. None of it was easy.
Through my toughest moments, I hear my mom's voice in my head telling me: **"Never tire of doing good, Val."** It's that lesson – that unbeatable drive – that propels me forward as I work day in and day out to take down a powerful GOP incumbent, deliver a Democratic Senate majority and expand access to the American dream.
**But the reality is that I can't win this alone. I need your support if I'm going to compete with Marco Rubio's dark-money machine. | **COURTS REJECT LAWSUIT TO BLOCK VOTE ON MARIJUANA LEGALIZATION**
Amendment 3 seeking to legalize recreational marijuana use by adults will remain on the Nov. 8 statewide ballot after a state appellate panel rejected a lawsuit seeking to block the measure and the Missouri Supreme Court declined to review the case.

The lawsuit, brought by an anti-drug activist, argued Secretary of State Jay Ashcroft failed to follow normal procedures in determining the initiative petition for Amendment 3 had sufficient signatures from registered Missouri voters to qualify for the ballot. The lawsuit also claimed the measure contains multiple subjects in violation of constitutional limitations.

Cole County Circuit Judge Cotton Walker, a Republican, dismissed the case Sept. 9, saying the plaintiff failed to prove she had legal standing to bring it. Although a three-judge panel of the Missouri Court of Appeals Western District on Sept. 12 said the lower court erred in determining the plaintiff lacked standing, it ruled against her on the merits of the case.

The appellate ruling found that while Amendment 3 contains a large number of provisions, they all relate to the single subject of marijuana legalization and regulation. The judges also said Ashcroft acted well within his authority in certifying Amendment 3 for the ballot. The following day, the state Supreme Court declined to take the case and let the appellate ruling stand. The case is _Joy Sweeney v. Jay Ashcroft_.

| **AFTER DELAYING SPECIAL SESSION, GOP ALSO PUNTS VETO SESSION**
After postponing the scheduled start of a special legislative session by eight days to figure out how to proceed with the governor’s request for a massive election-year tax cut, Republican leaders on Sept. 14 unexpectedly delayed action in the annual veto session by a week as they continued to formulate a special session plan.

The constitutionally mandated veto session provides lawmakers the opportunity to reconsider bills passed during the regular legislative session but rejected by the governor, and typically last just a couple hours. After gaveling into this year’s session, however, Republican leaders opted not to bring up the vetoed bills until later. Veto session will resume Sept. 20 in Senate and Sept. 21 in the House of Representatives.

In the separate special session, Gov. Mike Parson, a Republican, wants lawmakers to permanently slash income taxes by an estimated $700 million to $1.1 billion a year, with the benefit primarily going to the wealthy. He also is seeking a slew of targeted tax breaks for agricultural producers costing about another $40 million annually. However, the governor’s plan has encountered bipartisan opposition. Democrats and some fiscally cautious Republicans are concerned about the potentially devastating long-term impact the governor’s plan could have on state finances, while hardline-conservatives are demanding even larger tax cuts.

The special session was supposed to begin Sept. 6, but GOP leaders instructed lawmakers not to show up until Sept. 14 while they worked on building consensus. Although the special session finally got underway shortly after the brief proceedings in veto session, a solid plan for it remained undetermined.

If progress on the tax legislation isn’t made in the coming days, keeping the veto session in play preserves the option for lawmakers to override the veto of House Bill 1720, which contains the agricultural tax breaks the governor is seeking in special session. Parson vetoed the bill because it sunsets the breaks after just two years instead of six years, as the governor prefers.

Lawmakers likely will split the special session issues in two, with the income tax provisions included in one bill that will originate in the Senate and the agricultural tax credits going in a second bill filed in the House.

In another surprise move, House GOP leaders on Sept. 15 referred a bill to committee that would legalize sports gambling in Missouri and signaled they intend to bring up the legislation for debate on the House floor. Since the Missouri Constitution prohibits lawmakers from legislating on issues not authorized by the governor’s special session call, the bill would be unconstitutional if it were to pass unless the governor later expanded the scope of the special session to include it.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=62454ea95f&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: What if you could never vote for your Senators again, because they were elected by your state legislators instead? That’s Don Bolduc’s vision. He’s the Republican running to defeat Sen. Maggie Hassan of New Hampshire, and he wants to repeal the 17th Amendment. Can we make sure that doesn’t happen, Peter?
body:
Maggie Hassan for the direct election of Senators
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcf1e173f-1a99-4a60-96bd-fe5a1a73d74e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **
---
|
---

---
| **This would ensure that along with the bias towards small states (ie Wyoming having as many Senators as California), monied interests who've already bought state legislators would get to pick Senators in larger states where they've gerrymandered Democrats into a minority (see Ohio, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Texas, etc). ** **_Meanwhile, Maggie Hassan is one of the most forceful voices on codifying Roe, protecting women's rights and ensuring MORE PEOPLE VOTE, not fewer like millions fewer as Bolduc wants._** _We must defeat Republicans in November._ We must, in particular, defeat dangerous extremist Bolduc and reelect Senator Maggie Hassan in New Hampshire. We not only need this great Senator in the Senate, but her seat could decide whether we remain in the majority or Mitch McConnell becomes the new Senate leader. * We've given parents a voice to advocate for their children.
* And despite all of the upset, Florida's response to COVID has been more successful than the heavy lockdown states like Michigan and New Jersey.

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. body:
| Peter,

The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. Historic attacks on the right to vote, on a woman's right to choose, and on our children's right to be free of gun violence will either destroy this great state or will be overcome by the resolve and power of the people of Texas.

Greg Abbott has prioritized extreme fringe policies instead of expanding health care, fixing the grid, or improving public education. He signed the nation’s most extreme abortion bill into law with no exception for rape or incest. And he refuses to lift a finger to reduce gun violence after six major mass shootings have occurred on his watch.

Despite all of that — or maybe because of all of that — Texans are standing up to be counted in the fight for a far better Texas. It's inspiring how the people of this great state are choosing to meet the moment. Already, 90,000 volunteers have signed up for voter contact shifts to reach millions of voters wherever they are across Texas. And we have taken this campaign to literally every part of the state — showing up for everyone and writing no one off.

But we face a real challenge in overcoming the millions of dollars that Greg Abbott was able to raise from special interests before we ever entered the race. He'll use that to lie to voters about my record and try to keep them from turning out. And there's a chance he'll succeed if we don't have the resources to fight back.

[So I need your help, Peter, to make sure we can hire more organizers, open new field offices, run ads, and ultimately reach all of the voters who will decide this election. name: Cheri Beasley
subject: unexpected
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
When we launched this campaign, I wasn’t sure what to expect honestly.
#

When we launched this campaign, I wasn’t sure what to expect honestly.
I worried about how much this race would cost because I knew Republicans would pump tens of millions of dollars into our state, as they are doing right now. I also knew that we needed to run a campaign the right way. That meant rejecting corporate PAC money because DC special interests should not be allowed to buy Senate seats.
It was clear that we’d need a whole lot of folks like you joining us to fight back. So I put my faith in you, and we kicked off a campaign with a new playbook unlike anyone has tried in North Carolina before.
And right after our announcement, the response was immediate and overwhelming. Sonya, a teacher from Charlotte, chipped in $5. Then Catherine from Boone, a health care worker, made a $20 recurring contribution, and moments later, Anna, a social worker from Durham, gave $50...and we were off.
You probably didn’t wake up expecting to contribute to our campaign today. But in a race that pundits didn’t expect to be one of the most competitive ones in the country as it is now, we have to keep doing the unexpected because we know that’s what it takes to flip a Senate seat blue in the South.
[**Will you please consider making a $3 contribution to our campaign today to turn out the voters we need to win? | | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Why should you donate if our race isn’t competitive?
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220919-3406-header&t=1&akid=3406%2E2526796%2EM1A3P2)
Look, we know you get a lot of emails asking for donations. It can get tiring, and we understand. **We know some of you are also asking why you should make a donation here instead of giving to a candidate facing a race in a swing district or state.**
Here’s why:
**_Reason 1: We rely entirely on you._**
Our campaign takes **0** corporate donations. There’s no super PAC or big donor coming in to protect us from the attacks constantly coming our way. So if our donations drop, as they have been starting to lately, we will have to reassess our budget and make tough cuts.
**_Reason 2: Our last election was the second most expensive House race in the country._**
Our last Republican challenger in 2020 raised $10 million. And we can’t let those attacks go unanswered because they could chip away at the credibility of the Congresswoman and her policies, even if they aren’t initially successful in kicking her out of office. So we are still very much in campaign mode. We still have to pay for expensive radio and digital ads, and we are running a field program that stretches across two boroughs.
**_Reason 3: We organize a lot of community-building programs, outside of traditional election work._**
We aren’t a traditional campaign, and we know that’s part of why you’re here. During the pandemic, we ran a food distribution program that lasted for over a year. We organized a Census outreach program in 2020 that helped New Yorkers keep a congressional seat. We run a Homework Helpers program that tutors students in our district. And last weekend, we gave out thousands of backpacks to support families going back to school. **But to keep doing untraditional work like this, we need to keep our budget strong.**
[We know you can make a donation a lot of places, particularly this election season. But we hope we’ve explained why we also need you to keep giving here — even if it’s small. Our average donation is $14.74. Can you chip in $14.74 – or anything you can – today to help keep our campaign going strong?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220919-mu.1j5cuD&refcode=em20220919-3406-P_FND_RES_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3406%2E2526796%2EM1A3P2)

From all of us here on the campaign, we thank you for your continued support.
Team AOC

There is nothing the legacy media hates more than someone who challenges their fake narratives.

**_That must be why I'm number one on their hit list._**

Over the past few years, liberals locked down citizens, destroyed the economy and did an unknown amount of damage to the physical and mental health of their communities...

But I kept Florida **_FREE._**

I stood up to the big government, anti-science lies throughout the COVID pandemic. I kept our businesses open and our kids in school. I kept the woke agenda OUT. As a result, Florida is thriving.

And the fake news just can't take it. [**_FIGHT THE FAKE NARRATIVES >>_**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ee20738154094045b9d401c48fe1df3a&_e=6cnJpauyxGJqKWgWdgX7rsQbCX8WH4PyxWbvR07oB9Bocqt78mwZuc4mouo6LESiSz6Z0BIQ0PzIBB-0iki0hFXQ5xBTT-zQmQBsLPX1J3BMemQkpmb7YCcI2FEN1q6GZTHQxkWjAKTCkVdyJ15I4h0d1M9PPBhOBf1ITcsTAdtRNUoIPjNbYArJsYPGYo5zMGWFPggTp13BCk8D8pkeYE8mK7m4eoXiNin_kZjieDEI6mFsyux5WFGNu7jeHVNezdnATQrvtSqMaf9BL8dDK6024XgDFpjgqTnsE-kX1rnra7p73gQeOnwSHmkLSwre2ttuwOrpaP66CLdfGvPQPA%3D%3D)

To soften the crushing blow of our successes, the Leftist media has invented "scandal" after "scandal" in a desperate attempt to intimidate us.

They try to stir the pot on books, free speech, and our COVID policies - going so far as to call us a "death cult."

**_But all of it is a lie!_**

* We've given parents a voice to advocate for their children.
* And despite all of the upset, Florida's response to COVID has been more successful than the heavy lockdown states like Michigan and New Jersey.

**_You won't see it on TV, but that's THE TRUTH._**

**To me, the truth still matters.** And I will always defend the truth, even if it is unpopular to do so or goes against the "mainstream."

[**_Will you join me in fighting the legacy media's fake narratives - and proving them wrong - by chipping in today?_**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ee20738154094045b9d401c48fe1df3a&_e=6cnJpauyxGJqKWgWdgX7rsQbCX8WH4PyxWbvR07oB9Bocqt78mwZuc4mouo6LESiSz6Z0BIQ0PzIBB-0iki0hFXQ5xBTT-zQmQBsLPX1J3BMemQkpmb7YCcI2FEN1q6GZTHQxkWjAKTCkVdyJ15I4h0d1M9PPBhOBf1ITcsTAdtRNUoIPjNbYArJsYPGYo5zOSCeuM0hUD-NMWwoQVByOYT73cFVMHrrx5qHZJl4ochz7MLmI82fJL79BgtXx4KkHBOv8qfPog9RYwYfWFBaUUQYTIQFdKBkg0l9tOcAU_CUDzwHpdO-2Hth_9lslKZJCt8gehrGiDvmBDPw63H3og%3D%3D)

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: SIGN: Say NO to the GOP abortion ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Enough is enough.
#
Just a few months ago, Republicans were loudly declaring that abortion access must be decided at the state level. Now, Republicans, led by Senator Lindsey Graham, have introduced a nationwide abortion ban.
So let’s be clear:**their anti-abortion obsession has nothing to do with the constitution,** or democracy, or “letting the people decide.” It has ALWAYS been about power and control over our bodies.
Senator Graham’s proposed national abortion ban is unconscionable. We know this has been the GOP’s plan all along.**If Republicans take control of Congress in November, they WILL try to ban abortion nationwide.** This is a direct attack on the will of the people – we can’t let it happen.
**It’s time to fight back and show we will NEVER accept ANY abortion ban.[**If you agree, please join me and voice your opposition to the GOP’s shameless attempts to strip millions of Americans of our human rights.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/Oppose-GOP-Abortion-Ban/?source=em20220919-1638&t=1&akid=1638%2E420207%2EPjjdkR)**
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/Oppose-GOP-Abortion-Ban/?source=em20220919-1638&t=2&akid=1638%2E420207%2EPjjdkR)**
**A nationwide abortion ban is now an official policy position of the Republican Party.** They WILL pass this and other extreme measures if given the chance. Millions of people have now lost abortion access in America.**One in THREE women between the ages of 15 and 44 no longer have the right to abortion** where they live.
What’s more, abortion bans don’t *just* affect actual abortions. They can affect all aspects of pregnant people’s healthcare, taking critical decisions away from patients and their doctors. **There is nothing “pro-life” about banning abortions.**
Enough is enough. We must do everything we can to ensure this extreme bill fails.
[**Peter, can I count on your signature so show the GOP that we will not stand for an abortion ban – now or EVER?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/Oppose-GOP-Abortion-Ban/?source=em20220919-1638&t=3&akid=1638%2E420207%2EPjjdkR)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/Oppose-GOP-Abortion-Ban/?source=em20220919-1638&t=4&akid=1638%2E420207%2EPjjdkR)**
We are all in this fight together.
In solidarity,
Pramila

body:
You can make a real difference in the fight for abortion rights.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=951%2E61531%2EeSg6C_)
Hello,
I’m proud to be a strong ally in the fight to protect and expand abortion rights in Vermont and across the country.
But with the Senate currently split 50-50, the slimmest of margins for Democrats with President Biden in office, we can’t afford to lose _any_ Senate seats if we want to make real progress on abortion rights and other progressive values.
That’s why I’m working this year not just to win my election to represent Vermont in the Senate, but to help elect other progressives across the country who will fight for our shared values.
**I’ve been proud to support women running for office throughout my time in public service, and this year, six inspiring women are running in tight Senate elections—so they need our help.**
[**Will you split a donation to help reelect Sens. Catherine Cortez Masto, Maggie Hassan, Patty Murray, and Tammy Duckworth AND help Cheri Beasley and Val Demings defeat anti-choice Republicans this November? 100% of your donation goes directly to these 6 candidates!**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4233?t=3&akid=951%2E61531%2EeSg6C_)
[DONATE ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4233?t=7&t=8&akid=951%2E61531%2EeSg6C_)
---
With less than two months until Election Day, and polls showing all of these races neck-and-neck, your support will make a real difference in the fight for abortion rights and other progressive values.
Your grassroots contributions will immediately be put to work talking to voters about the stakes in this year’s elections.
**With so much at stake, and these races tight in the polls, this is a great time to make your voice heard.**
I’d be so grateful if you made a split donation today to help elect six amazing women to the Senate: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/supportsenatewomen](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4233?t=4&akid=951%2E61531%2EeSg6C_)**
With your help, I’ll join the Senate alongside these amazing colleagues—and we’ll never stop fighting for abortion access, voting rights, climate justice, and more.
Thanks so much,
Peter

Chabot’s 26 years in Washington, D.C. have been defined by nothing more than extreme votes, failed leadership, and hyper-partisanship.
* He’s **spent his entire career fighting to outlaw abortion nationwide** – no exceptions.

name: Raya Salter, Evergreen Action
subject: My response to Tucker Carlson and Rep. Clay Higgins
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
They came for me because I stood up against petrochemicals.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4350?t=2&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS) Friend, When I went to Capitol Hill last week to testify about Big Oil and the dangers of petrochemicals to frontline communities, I knew I would face Republican resistance. **But I never expected to be yelled at, demeaned, and targeted by Tucker Carlson and the entire right-wing disinformation machine.** [_**If you already saw these viral clips and know what went down, click here to share my response and fight back right away.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4350?t=3&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS) | [SHARE TWEET](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4350?t=4&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS)
---
Let me introduce myself. I'm an attorney and the founder and executive director of the [_**Energy Justice Law and Policy Center**_](http://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4351?t=5&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS), the nation's first grassroots public interest law firm devoted to energy justice. I'm also a member of Evergreen's advisory board. It's nice to meet you, though I wish it were under better circumstances.
During my testimony, Rep. Clay Higgins (R-Louisiana) launched into a racist and misogynistic rant against me, shouting over me and calling me "young lady" and "boo."
Don't worry—I shot right back at him that the fossil fuel industry that owns his state is destroying the earth.
But then Tucker Carlson invited Rep. Higgins on his vile show to _thank and congratulate him_ for attacking me.
You know what happens next: As soon as that segment aired, online hordes began bombarding me with foul language, nasty messages, and threats against my life.
I want you to know that I am unbothered, undeterred, and unapologetically staying focused.
**This disgusting propaganda campaign is an attempt to obscure the real issue—that Big Oil and the petrochemical industry are poisoning frontline communities and undermining climate action in order to keep making their products and profits.**
[_**So today, I'm asking you to fight back against these right-wing attacks by sharing my response thread and spreading our message.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4350?t=6&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS)
[SHARE TWEET](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4350?t=7&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS)
---
Together, we will stand up against misogyny, stand for environmental justice, and win the future we deserve. We will not be stopped by the fossil fuel industry, their disinformation, or the politicians they bought and paid for.
Onward,
[](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4350?t=8&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS)
Raya Salter
Evergreen Advisory Board Member
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [Click here to unsubscribe](https://act.evergreenaction.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=9&akid=13099%2E53494%2EuOBhVS). Contributions or gifts to EVERGREEN ACTION are not tax deductible. | PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION

subject: What if your Senators were elected by your state legislators? That’s how it used to be done before 1912, when the 17th Amendment was passed. Don Bolduc, the Republican who’s running against Sen. Maggie Hassan of New Hampshire, wants to repeal the 17th Amendment and end the right of every ordinary voter to elect their Senators. Can you help us stop this madness?
body:
Sen. Maggie Hassan for NH
| | | | |

| | |

| | | | | Peter, **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9e54c076-3d9a-4ff8-8a4e-a315c9d304ff/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **

**Friend – 50 days _._ That's how long we have to defeat Herschel Walker, keep Georgia blue, and defend our Senate majority.**
My roots are planted deeply in Georgia's soil. I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah, graduated from Morehouse College, and then went on to preach from Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s pulpit. Today, I walk the halls of Congress as the first Black senator in Georgia's history. **It is one of the greatest honors of my life.**
I'm committed to making sure that the next generation has the same opportunities I did, but I need your help: Walker is spending more than $20 million to defeat me, and polls show us _neck and neck_.
**With _FiveThirtyEight_ confirming that our race will decide Senate control, we need to fight back ASAP, or we could lose this seat and our majority. So I'm personally asking: ****[Will you chip in $5 or more right now so we can defeat Herschel Walker, win this race, and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50981172/367858338/-1789705490?amp;amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4263-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTc1N2U2Ni02ZDM4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JAiu9BXiF7RXY--C6dv7PFGMVY0YsnbNFzAoaY89Au8=)**

name: Brenda for Gov
subject: 10 for 10
body:
| |

Friend, There are just ten days left until our deadline on September 28th. Right now is the most critical moment in our race. It is the make or break moment. It is critical that we step up our fundraising in order to turn this momentum into a win. We still have significant money to raise by the end of the month to meet our goal. We know times are tough and money is tight for everyone. But Brenda needs your help so she can stand for all of us. Here are ten reasons donating to Brenda is worth the investment:
1. Brenda slept on the state capitol steps out in the cold for 27 days to ensure all Vermonters would not freeze to death last winter.
2. She will devote the resources necessary to combat the Overdose Crisis.
3. Brenda knows that our planet needs bold climate action now.
4. She doesn’t take money from big corporations, pharmaceutical companies or fossil fuels.
5. She pushed through key legislation supporting Vermonters with substance use disorder and legislation assisting families who had lost their homes due to the pandemic despite the Republican administration’s opposition.
6. Brenda has the support of many Vermont State Legislators, Governor Howard Dean, Vermont NEA, Vermont State Employees Association and more.
7. She[ has a detailed plan](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDPPzVAl8cO0gYyIMWADgMrVRAmvV_P3bg_Xk0HKGRKtRvU55-H3wPZr5KW--zop9KRY_C0_oPCHbm5zrtuRWLUvwwrUdfNCENJQzhNigFm7y_wdYPCMeAFeCh0cLL1C7CfSVGGQwhbHuKN4FLJMGNUhYlmohvoTUuCtb8U7-HILt-TIM0hd4BbXf6OOvnaxywrnETyvAaBhs9srm3c6DqP53374p5CzLqus1uWelFToSyE7f97HQ6-d9zfwjnOFpjpwbq-8C_mAj30FrvN757oPcE6cBip_-llX9JxS7I8Jh/3pl/Zz-3196rTdSKa1UTMerZWg/h0/LnF_tIVSTGnNk-9GvbHHjPujRJadVfk-rgAPx3rEA6A) to make Vermont a safe haven for reproductive and civil liberties.
8. Brenda would be the second women Governor and the first single mom and openly bisexual person to hold the office.
9. She’s endorsed by each of the top three grassroots climate organizations in Vermont.
10. Brenda has consistently stood up for teachers and state employees when the GOP administration left them behind.

We could keep listing more of Brenda’s many accolades, but we know your time is valuable. So we'll leave it at ten reasons. clean_body: | | Friend, There are just ten days left until our deadline on September 28th. Right now is the most critical moment in our race. It is the make or break moment. It is critical that we step up our fundraising in order to turn this momentum into a win. We still have significant money to raise by the end of the month to meet our goal. We know times are tough and money is tight for everyone. But Brenda needs your help so she can stand for all of us. Here are ten reasons donating to Brenda is worth the investment: 1. Brenda slept on the state capitol steps out in the cold for 27 days to ensure all Vermonters would not freeze to death last winter. 2. She will devote the resources necessary to combat the Overdose Crisis. 3. Brenda knows that our planet needs bold climate action now. 4. She doesn’t take money from big corporations, pharmaceutical companies or fossil fuels. 5. She pushed through key legislation supporting Vermonters with substance use disorder and legislation assisting families who had lost their homes due to the pandemic despite the Republican administration’s opposition. 6. Brenda has the support of many Vermont State Legislators, Governor Howard Dean, Vermont NEA, Vermont State Employees Association and more. 7. She to make Vermont a safe haven for reproductive and civil liberties. 8. Brenda would be the second women Governor and the first single mom and openly bisexual person to hold the office. 9. She’s endorsed by each of the top three grassroots climate organizations in Vermont. 10. Brenda has consistently stood up for teachers and state employees when the GOP administration left them behind. We could keep listing more of Brenda’s many accolades, but we know your time is valuable. So we'll leave it at ten reasons. Brenda needs our help raising enough money to stay competitive in this race. Friend,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what’s never going to change.

**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0e7c0c4e1287403c85b57fa96696a750&_e=UBCnX41FCf2Ltq5tFjRgTNMaaQiwUeOV90sqdbCnN-rIUFxz0j-5WfrPscVeP3dqTumhrxn4b3eZojn8loyp_zYFNe-jWf4viy558h_3YPAMc_-p5KD1-EY_sdxb7ut8US_n8iH245vMrHv4uTI3thNHTC39JNjwcZcD6e-Njlfe9tZxWAzkWQgwyYgvf-nnp384Njr0uHkHXEs9lIIoOTZhG9u_vfiRjJ0YMWs9mRWSXOHDgE9GV7TY8v4zwfK33SEDyffuBdMTV6Kw2YqGwzkcLQh9HRxr67H1n8uGzSnE1UDobiwmUQjN6mDzSZE5URybaB8ydeDYPyOa-UupHZKkWUk9tZoKGDbrfg6DpOchhu8QXQc8fqlpfylb-eMkDm1GXF3Gw59Rx3VwhXmZWe2ghOuOMONYNArDif8Jz8J4wGRgpkX6LfyuFMfiUbAfX5EBxwfmblcZ6uCmRd39Hw%3D%3D)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what’d I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state’s $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer’s Cabinet.
